brief_rationale: The doctor systematically reconciled medications, identified pending pathology, corrected the family's colonoscopy/pathology misconception using concrete document evidence, and built an executable checklist with fallback contacts. No responsibility-chain error occurred; RC1–RC7 were met. High-order points HO1, HO3, and HO4 were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, while HO2 was triggered but only partially integrated. Closure is safe, executable, and traceable as valid_closure. This satisfies Strong with multiple high-order completions, but HO2 only partial and no medication red-flag (RC5) error blocks Perfect.
